description: This file contains tests for the observability forwarder component in a Go-based project. It includes mock implementations, unit tests for configuration normalization, lifecycle management, event transformation, signature generation, webhook delivery, error handling, redrive functionality, filtering logic, and batching behavior.

classes.name: mockObservabilityStore
classes.description: A mock implementation of ObservabilityWebhookStore for testing purposes, providing thread-safe methods to manipulate webhook configuration and dead letter queue entries.

methods.name: normalizeObservabilityConfig
methods.description: Function to normalize the forwarder configuration by setting default values for zero or unset fields.

methods.name: NewObservabilityForwarder
methods.description: Constructor function to create a new instance of the observability forwarder.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Method to start the forwarder's processing routines.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Method to gracefully stop the forwarder.

methods.name: ReloadConfig
methods.description: Method to reload and apply the latest webhook configuration.

methods.name: GetStatus
methods.description: Method to retrieve the current status of the forwarder.

methods.name: transformExecutionEvent
methods.description: Transform an execution event into an observability event.

methods.name: transformNodeEvent
methods.description: Transform a node event into an observability event.

methods.name: transformReasonerEvent
methods.description: Transform a reasoner event into an observability event.

methods.name: computeBackoff
methods.description: Calculate exponential backoff duration based on retry attempt count, capped at maximum.

methods.name: generateObservabilitySignature
methods.description: Create an HMAC SHA256 signature of the request body using the secret key for webhook authentication.

methods.name: enqueueEvent
methods.description: Internal method to enqueue an event for batching, used in tests.

methods.name: Redrive
methods.description: Attempt to reprocess events in the dead letter queue, sending them via webhook.
